summary: Completed end-to-end testing for Safe Steps marketing site (Spanish, dark theme). Backend: 13/13 pytest tests pass covering health, products list/filter/by-id, contact create/list/validation, advisory create/validation, and verification that no MongoDB _id leaks. Frontend: All critical UI flows verified via Playwright on the public URL — hero with 2 CTAs, navbar with 6 links + Descarga la App CTA, products grid renders 6 cards from API, filter chip 'collares' correctly narrows to 2 cards, buy button shows success toast, floating contact button appears after scroll>280, contact form successfully submits and clears, footer with 3 columns renders.

issues: Empty-form submit relies on HTML5 'required' attribute (browser tooltip) instead of the in-app toast 'Completa nombre, email y mensaje'. The JS guard exists but is unreachable because inputs have required attribute. Functional but inconsistent with custom toast UX. Consider removing 'required' from inputs to let JS validation toast fire, or remove the toast guard for consistency.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Decide between HTML5 'required' validation vs JS toast for empty contact form (currently both coded, but HTML5 wins). Either remove 'required' attributes from name/email/message inputs or remove the JS validation toast for consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py correctly excludes _id via projection {'_id': 0} in all reads — verified.
Pydantic models use EmailStr → 422 on bad email; payload validation is solid.
All interactive elements have data-testid — excellent testability.
Frontend uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — no hardcoded URLs.
Minor: Contact form has both HTML5 required and JS toast guard; HTML5 always wins so JS toast for empty submit is dead code.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_ contact messages and 1 TEST_ advisory request in MongoDB during test runs (all prefixed with TEST_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_safesteps_api.py covers all endpoints (13 tests). Public URL: https://safesteps-app.preview.emergentagent.com. All data-testid attributes are reliable. Single-page Spanish landing — sections: hero, about, products, how, app, contact, footer. The only behavior nuance is the contact form empty-submit using browser-native HTML5 validation instead of the coded JS toast.
rca of the issue: No critical issues found. Validation 'failure' in playwright was expected: inputs have HTML5 `required`, so empty submit is blocked by browser before the JS handler runs. This is correct UX, just inconsistent with the toast text in code.
